nodes.claim: Reuse Qwen/mmproj visual encode for MVC and semantic escalation.
One vision forward exposes pre-merger and merged outputs; merged path is available before language decode.
Encoded merged media embeddings are publicly retrievable after encode.
High-quality multimodal retrieval uses retrieval-specific training and final hidden-state pooling/normalization rather than assuming raw visual projector geometry is calibrated.
Visual correctness/stability can depend on runtime/preprocessor/backend/batch/KV/FA conditions.
Test merged reuse first; tiny projection second; pre-merger only if needed; dedicated encoder remains mandatory counterbaseline.
Bind prototype validity to a complete VisualEncoderCompatibilityID and measure cross-runtime geometry/behavior drift.

fusion_result: Evidence supports implementation of a same-encode MVC experiment but does not support promotion of raw Qwen/mmproj features as a calibrated familiarity space. The minimum-complexity next move is a merged-feature benchmark with strict runtime identity and a dedicated-encoder counterbaseline.
